svg.title: Jorge Lim · GitLab activity · 2025
svg.desc: 1,248 recorded activities · 181 active days. Recovered partial history, not the original GitLab calendar. Includes commits, merge request actions, comments, approvals and commit-update notes. Colors indicate 0, 1–3, 4–7, 8–14 and 15 or more records per day. Future dates are faded. See archive coverage details for limitations.
